Scratch pad allocation APIs, frame management, safety checks, and alloca helpers.

# Purpose
This header defines the public API for thread-local scratch pad memory allocation in `fd_scratch`. It provides functions to attach and detach a scratch region, manage scratch frames, prepare and publish variable-size allocations, trim recent allocations, and query safe use conditions. The file also defines alignment and footprint helpers for the scratch memory and metadata regions, plus optional run-time checks and sanitizer hooks for error detection. When `FD_HAS_ALLOCA` is enabled, it also exposes `fd_alloca` and `fd_alloca_check` as stack-based allocation helpers with alignment support.
